title: Suit Styling for Everyday Wear: Tailoring Beyond the Boardroom
excerpt: Learn how to style suits for daily wear with confidence. Discover relaxed tailoring, fabric choices, and accessories that make suiting practical for casual and semi-formal settings.
content:
## The Rise of Relaxed Tailoring

Relaxed tailoring has emerged as a dominant trend. Brands like Suitsupply lead with unstructured blazers and soft-shouldered jackets. A relaxed-fit suit from Suitsupply ranges from $400 to $700. COS offers deconstructed suiting from $250 to $400.

## Choosing the Right Fabric and Fit

For year-round versatility, choose mid-weight wool between 260 and 300 gsm. A navy or charcoal wool suit from Suitsupply provides an ideal foundation ($499-$799). Fit is critical: the jacket should button comfortably, sleeves show quarter inch of shirt cuff, trousers break once at the shoe.

## Styling a Suit Without a Tie

Wear an open-collar shirt with top two buttons undone. Add a lightweight merino turtleneck from COS ($89-$129) underneath for coverage. Loafers or clean minimalist sneakers complete the look. A minimalist leather watch provides the finishing touch.

## Footwear Options for Everyday Suiting

Chelsea boots are the most versatile. Suede Chelsea boots from Massimo Dutti ($200-$280) pair with navy or grey suits. Loafers offer a sophisticated warm-weather alternative. Minimialist leather sneakers from COS at $190 add contemporary edge.

## Care and Maintenance for Daily Wear

Rotate between at least two suits. Hang on wide wooden hangers. Steam between wears. Dry clean only three to four times per year. Use cedar shoe trees. With proper care, a quality suit from Suitsupply or Massimo Dutti will serve you for five to eight years.

## The Rise of Relaxed Tailoring

Relaxed tailoring has emerged as the dominant trend in modern suiting. Brands like Suitsupply lead this revolution with unstructured blazers and soft-shouldered jackets that drape naturally. The key differentiators include lighter construction, minimal padding, and softer lapels. A relaxed-fit suit from Suitsupply typically ranges from $400 to $700, while COS offers deconstructed suiting from $250 to $400 that prioritizes comfort and movement. Massimo Dutti's travel-friendly suits ($350-$550) use stretch-infused wools that maintain shape throughout the day. The goal is to look intentional and put-together without appearing headed to a board meeting. This aesthetic works beautifully for dinners, gallery openings, weekend travel, and creative workplace environments. A navy unstructured blazer with grey flannel trousers and suede loafers is the quintessential relaxed tailoring outfit.

 A simple rule: if you'd wear the shoes with a full suit, they're probably too formal for everyday suiting. Conversely, if you'd wear them to the gym, they're definitely too casual. Find the middle ground with versatile options like chukka boots, derbies, or minimalist sneakers.
